description: This Java source file implements a GLSurfaceView.Renderer that renders a rotating textured triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 in an Android environment. It includes shader compilation, program linking, texture loading, and rendering logic.

classes.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer that draws and animates a textured triangle in OpenGL ES 2.0 for Android.

methods.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer and preparing vertex data buffer.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders the current frame: clears buffers, sets up shaders and textures, applies transformations, and draws the triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL state, compiles shaders, links program, loads textures, and sets up matrices.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles an OpenGL shader from source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates and links an OpenGL shader program from vertex and fragment shader sources.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws an exception if any are found.
